stem:
Sana reads the statement "25% of the bag of rice." The whole is the bag of rice.

Which two claims correctly read 25%?

options.text: 25% means 25 kg more than the whole bag of rice.
25% means $\frac{25}{100}$ of the bag of rice.
25% means 25 equal parts out of 100 equal parts of the bag of rice.
25% means $\frac{100}{25}$ of the bag of rice.

teacher.key_rationale: A percentage is a fraction with denominator 100, so 25% is 25/100 of the whole, or 25 out of 100 equal parts. Adding 25 kg over-scopes. Writing 100/25 reverses the fraction.
